There is no established or clinically proven standard dose of dihydromyricetin (DHM) to take after drinking alcohol, though typical supplement amounts used in overviews and products range from  [Highlight start] **300 mg to 1,000 mg** [Highlight end].[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpQEBxCJF16ZuGyItXJrWpv4M62kAV72ECsfYexnvK6I2B2ZrPz2uZo_qLu7Xi97RlKs0qDGFpsVP2SsNJzNX6opzCfneQbiXUhl3s9ab95bC3FFGb6oivXlZCv4YJjcKrhMHIR3lYuzJgUwk096etTnqDLrfoBKLli_KbnJb11kPSMZVWoZjoDroXYAcx_j3rXjceKlh9u6WrFNRfYJPH8LLRSmR_ts)

Most commercial DHM products are designed to be taken before or during drinking rather than afterward, and human clinical evidence on post-drinking dosing and hangover prevention remains limited.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXlnaYHcMjeWe8bFCYiN3FQOKed9tnMbwJEC9QKIalHlqSnqj2YwuaQiUYTFM5tdP1HrDVccxTKweH3WsOCYm6FZf_6s70cqTWdyB7hcg2oI8xWibgEBYFXd6A2223QqFqHL8DVgOW0-MMoSMVjc3gn1Uv_SubsO6RrA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpQEBxCJF16ZuGyItXJrWpv4M62kAV72ECsfYexnvK6I2B2ZrPz2uZo_qLu7Xi97RlKs0qDGFpsVP2SsNJzNX6opzCfneQbiXUhl3s9ab95bC3FFGb6oivXlZCv4YJjcKrhMHIR3lYuzJgUwk096etTnqDLrfoBKLli_KbnJb11kPSMZVWoZjoDroXYAcx_j3rXjceKlh9u6WrFNRfYJPH8LLRSmR_ts)

### Key Dosing & Safety Considerations

- **No official standard:** Supplement labels vary widely, and there is no medical consensus on an exact dose after alcohol consumption. Follow the specific product label and avoid stacking multiple DHM products.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXlnaYHcMjeWe8bFCYiN3FQOKed9tnMbwJEC9QKIalHlqSnqj2YwuaQiUYTFM5tdP1HrDVccxTKweH3WsOCYm6FZf_6s70cqTWdyB7hcg2oI8xWibgEBYFXd6A2223QqFqHL8DVgOW0-MMoSMVjc3gn1Uv_SubsO6RrA)
- **Limited human evidence:** Much of the research on DHM's effects on alcohol and liver pathways comes from animal or cell studies rather than large human trials . You can read more in this [scientific study on dihydromyricetin](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXNKcWMgTc2O8wFMTZUCJMK-5uWv8LzeshLtJ-xbtx5KJKtkRC4i5kY1fhEskelrTNm22QWy6SvphV-591huxZU2OUhjGTIuCmvmmjwYbTo72ekZqoU_X8jHx7ALYnA6gNsl539kgiLO2u).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpQEBxCJF16ZuGyItXJrWpv4M62kAV72ECsfYexnvK6I2B2ZrPz2uZo_qLu7Xi97RlKs0qDGFpsVP2SsNJzNX6opzCfneQbiXUhl3s9ab95bC3FFGb6oivXlZCv4YJjcKrhMHIR3lYuzJgUwk096etTnqDLrfoBKLli_KbnJb11kPSMZVWoZjoDroXYAcx_j3rXjceKlh9u6WrFNRfYJPH8LLRSmR_ts)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXNTjFcsgzMYixzBlNSj5mKwdbDi_kIQzL-kCgXjWheXg3ntK-SERx9baw4NpNLaVZs5QYnZsWCa-rGjZS25rIgi3WXY8HC_Xk32VZ1sc1HjzaGtsRO0p880CZP34r8Ny7lYRj5uhFeZXm)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXNKcWMgTc2O8wFMTZUCJMK-5uWv8LzeshLtJ-xbtx5KJKtkRC4i5kY1fhEskelrTNm22QWy6SvphV-591huxZU2OUhjGTIuCmvmmjwYbTo72ekZqoU_X8jHx7ALYnA6gNsl539kgiLO2u)
- **Medication interactions:** Lab studies suggest DHM can affect liver enzymes (such as CYP3A4, CYP2E1, and CYP2D6) involved in processing medications, which may alter how certain drugs work.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpQEBxCJF16ZuGyItXJrWpv4M62kAV72ECsfYexnvK6I2B2ZrPz2uZo_qLu7Xi97RlKs0qDGFpsVP2SsNJzNX6opzCfneQbiXUhl3s9ab95bC3FFGb6oivXlZCv4YJjcKrhMHIR3lYuzJgUwk096etTnqDLrfoBKLli_KbnJb11kPSMZVWoZjoDroXYAcx_j3rXjceKlh9u6WrFNRfYJPH8LLRSmR_ts)
- **Not a cure or sobriety aid:** DHM does not prevent intoxication, speed up alcohol clearance enough to sober you up, or replace hydration and rest.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXlnaYHcMjeWe8bFCYiN3FQOKed9tnMbwJEC9QKIalHlqSnqj2YwuaQiUYTFM5tdP1HrDVccxTKweH3WsOCYm6FZf_6s70cqTWdyB7hcg2oI8xWibgEBYFXd6A2223QqFqHL8DVgOW0-MMoSMVjc3gn1Uv_SubsO6RrA)
